title: Turn a Specification into a Verified Feature
competency: 02. Spec Framing - Skill-driven design, planning, test-first implementation, review, and verification
mission: Use Superpowers to deliver verified working code from the supplied approved specification.
domain: Team invitations with actor permissions, target-role policy, normalized identity, expiry, single-use state transitions, and immutable rejection behavior.
outcome: The learner produces a working invitation feature and evidence that connects the Superpowers workflow to design, tests, implementation, review, and verification.
seededDefects: The application has no invitation lifecycle or user interface.
An unsafe legacy helper mutates membership without authorization or validation.
Case-insensitive duplicates, expiry, guest policy, and repeated transitions can corrupt state.
The starter service throws until a test-driven implementation replaces it.
verificationGates: All fixed invitation acceptance tests pass unchanged.
Learner-written regressions demonstrate a committed red/green cycle.
The interface uses the shared service and is demonstrated in a real browser.
Superpowers invocation evidence, approved design, and plan precede implementation.
Independent review findings have verified dispositions.
Final source and test hashes match the captured and sealed verification.
agentWorkflow: Read the approved specification and record the unfinished baseline.
Use brainstorming to agree on technical design before writing-plans.
Execute the plan with a genuine learner-written failing test before production changes.
Implement and verify the feature, retaining the test-first regression.
Request independent code review and resolve its findings.
Demonstrate the UI and verify the final committed source before sealing evidence.
workingDeliverables: Working invitation service and Team Invitations interface
Approved design and native Superpowers plan
Workflow, requirement coverage, and UI evidence
Captured baseline, red, green, and final checks
